name: Motion for a resolution (as a whole)
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the case of Jean-Jacques Wondo in the Democratic Republic of the Congo
part_text:
The European Parliament is not changing any law here. It is stating its opinion and making requests. It condemns the death sentence given to Jean-Jacques Wondo, a Belgian-Congolese expert, and 36 others by a military court in the Democratic Republic of the Congo. It says their trial was unfair and the evidence unreliable. It asks the Congolese government to cancel the death sentences, stop all executions, release Wondo and give him medical care.

- Nothing changes yet; the Parliament only asks the Congo to cancel the death sentences and free Wondo.
- Wondo and 36 others sentenced to death are affected, plus Congo's courts.
- Next, EU diplomats are urged to press Congo's authorities on human rights and fair trials.
